words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: The population is growing exponentially.
words.ex_cn: 人口正在呈指数增长。
words.en: If something increases exponentially, it becomes larger at a faster and faster rate.

words.tr: phrase. 家喻户晓的事或人
words.ex: Coca-Cola is a household name in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 可口可乐在许多国家是家喻户晓的品牌。
words.en: A household name is a person or thing that is very well known.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.ex: He likes to dabble in painting on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末随便画画。
words.en: To take part in an activity in a way that is not serious or committed.

words.tr: phrase. 很多的；丰富的；大量的
words.ex: He has a wealth of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: A large amount of something valuable or useful.

words.ex: He learned English and put it to use in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他学了英语，并在工作中加以运用。
words.en: To use something for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 建立于；以…为基础；指望
words.ex: He built on his old ideas to make a new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他基于旧的想法制定了一个新计划。
words.en: To develop or increase something from a particular starting point or base.

words.tr: phrase. 重要的部分；基本的部分
words.ex: Hard work is part and parcel of being a successful student.
words.ex_cn: 努力学习是成为成功学生的必要部分。
words.en: An essential or integral component of something.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 再三地；反复不止地
words.ex: He tried again and again to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地尝试解决这个问题。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.ex: A host of students came to the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生来听讲座了。
words.en: A large number of something.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.ex: He parked his car on the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车道上。
words.en: A driveway is a private road that leads from a public road to a house or other building.

words.tr: n. 好管闲事的人；好事的人；多嘴的人
words.ex: He is a busybody who asks too many questions.
words.ex_cn: 他是个爱管闲事的人，总爱问太多问题。
words.en: A busybody is someone who is too interested in other people's lives and tries to get involved in their affairs when it is not necessary.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.tr:
n. 申斥；谴责
v. 斥责；训斥
words.ex: The teacher gave him a reprimand for talking in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他上课讲话而训斥了他。
words.en: A reprimand is a formal or official expression of disapproval, typically by a person in authority.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: adj. 手写的； v. “handwrite”的现在分词；
words.ex: He submitted a handwritten letter to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师提交了一封手写的信。
words.en: Written by hand, not printed or typed.

words.ex: He poured milk from a jug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个水壶里倒牛奶。
words.en: A jug is a container used for holding and pouring liquids. It typically has a handle and a spout for easy pouring.

words.ex: She ate the freshly baked bread.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了刚烤好的面包。
words.en: Recently; just now.

words.ex: The potter made a clay bowl by hand.
words.ex_cn: 陶工用手制作了一个陶碗。
words.en: A potter is someone who makes pottery, and to potter means to busy oneself in a desultory but pleasant manner.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: He was arrested for hanging out with lowlifes.
words.ex_cn: 他因与社会渣滓混在一起而被逮捕。
words.en: A lowlife is someone who is considered to be dishonest, immoral, or of low social status.

words.tr:
n. 卫星导航系统
abbr. 卫星导航系统；“satellite navigation”的缩写
words.ex: He uses satnav to find the way to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他使用卫星导航寻找去机场的路。
words.en: Satnav is a system that uses satellites to determine the position of a vehicle, ship, aircraft, or person in order to calculate a route.

words.ex: The knife left a nick on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 刀在木桌上留下了一道刻痕。
words.en: A nick is a small cut or notch in a surface or edge. As a verb, to nick means to make a small cut or notch in something, or to steal something.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: He scarcely ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃任何东西。
words.en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.ex: The venality of the officials led to widespread corruption.
words.ex_cn: 官员的唯利是图导致了普遍的腐败。
words.en: The quality or state of being venal; readiness to sell one's services or influence for money or other benefits.

words.tr: adj. 令人震惊的； v. “shock”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was shocking to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: If something is shocking, it is extremely surprising and upsetting.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: The guard is vigilant at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名守卫在夜里非常警惕。
words.en: Someone who is vigilant gives careful attention to a particular problem or situation and concentrates on noticing any danger or trouble that there might be.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr: n. 英国货币；英镑；标准纯银；银制品；
words.ex: He paid for the book with sterling.
words.ex_cn: 他用英镑支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: Sterling is used to describe something of very high quality or value. It can also refer to British money or a standard of purity for silver.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.ex: My teacher will get after me if I don't finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 如果我不完成作业，老师会督促我。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something; to scold or urge someone to do something.

words.ex: He double back to find his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他折返回去找钥匙。
words.en: To return along the same path that one has just come.

words.tr: phrase. 撕下；匆匆完成；跑掉
words.ex: He tore off the label from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子上的标签撕掉了。
words.en: To remove something by pulling it roughly or violently.

words.ex: He forgot his keys, but just as well, the door was open.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钥匙，但也好，门是开着的。
words.en: Used to say that it is a good thing that something happened or was done because if it had not, the situation would be worse.

words.tr: phrase. 与...一起住；接受并忍受
words.ex: He has to live with the noise from the street.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不忍受来自街道的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or accept something unpleasant; to cohabit with someone.

words.ex: He didn't bat an eye when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 他看到蛇时连眼睛都没眨一下。
words.en: If someone does not bat an eye, they do not show any surprise or shock.

words.ex: I have in mind a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 我心中有一个简单的计划。
words.en: If you have something in mind, you are thinking about it as a possibility or as a thing that you want to do.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He perks up when he hears his favorite song.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到他最喜欢的歌曲时，他变得兴奋起来。
words.en: To become or make someone become more cheerful or lively.

words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.ex: He can leave for work at a moment's notice.
words.ex_cn: 他可以随时出发去上班。
words.en: If you can do something at a moment's notice, you can do it immediately, without any preparation.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
v. 挥；舞动；炫耀地显示
n. 挥舞
words.ex: He brandished a knife to scare the thief.
words.ex_cn: 他挥舞着一把刀吓唬小偷。
words.en: If you brandish something, especially a weapon, you wave it about in a threatening way.

words.ex: The child squirted water from the hose.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从软管里喷出水。
words.en: To squirt means to force out liquid in a thin fast stream or to be forced out in this way.

words.ex: The boy shot water with a squirt gun.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用喷水枪射水。
words.en: A squirt gun is a toy gun that shoots water.

words.ex: The children are playing with a beach ball.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在玩一个沙滩球。
words.en: A beach ball is a large, light ball that is used for playing games on the beach.

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.tr:
adj. 激励的；充满活力（或激情）的；令人振奋的
v. 唤醒；觉醒；“rouse”的现在分词
words.ex: The speech was a rousing call to action.
words.ex_cn: 这次演讲是一次激动人心的行动号召。
words.en: Causing great excitement or enthusiasm; stirring.

words.tr: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；
words.ex: He is a famous orator who speaks at large events.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在大型活动中演讲的著名演说者。
words.en: An orator is a person who delivers speeches or lectures, especially one who is skilled at doing so.

words.ex: He stood on the podium to receive the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他站在领奖台上领取金牌。
words.en: A podium is a small platform on which someone stands to give a speech or conduct an orchestra, or on which a medal winner stands during a prize-giving ceremony.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: He scrolls through his newsfeed every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上浏览他的信息流。
words.en: A newsfeed is a list of recent news articles or updates, especially on a social media website or application, that is automatically updated as new content is published.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: The music resonates with her emotions.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与她的情感产生共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates, it vibrates and produces a deep, strong sound. If a place or situation resonates, it seems full of a particular quality or feeling.

words.tr: adv. 独特地；唯一地；珍奇地；
words.ex: She uniquely solves every math problem.
words.ex_cn: 她独特地解决每一个数学问题。
words.en: In a way that is unlike anything else; uniquely.

words.ex: He reread the book to understand it better.
words.ex_cn: 他重新读了这本书，以便更好地理解。
words.en: To read (something) again.

words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.ex: The document uses a clean font.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档使用了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: A font is a set of printable or displayable text characters in a specific style and size.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.tr: adj. 痛切的；酸楚的；强烈的；尖刻的
words.ex: The letter was poignant and made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 这封信很感人，让她哭了。
words.en: A poignant piece of writing or music makes you feel sad or full of pity.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.tr:
n. 相反；
adj. 相反的；
words.ex: The contrary of hot is cold.
words.ex_cn: 热的相反是冷。
words.en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

words.ex: He is averse to changing his routine.
words.ex_cn: 他反对改变自己的日常安排。
words.en: If you say that someone is averse to something, you mean they dislike it or have a strong opposition to it.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: Challenges lie ahead for the new team.
words.ex_cn: 新团队前方有挑战等着。
words.en: If something lies ahead, especially something that is going to happen, it is going to happen in the future and you will have to deal with it.

words.ex: He will step down from the stage after the speech.
words.ex_cn: 演讲结束后，他会走下舞台。
words.en: To resign from a position or to reduce the intensity, amount, or level of something.

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.ex: The story resonate with many people.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事引起了众多人的共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates with you, it feels true or has a special meaning for you.

words.ex: Many students fall away from the program after the first month.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在第一个月后离开了这个项目。
words.en: If something falls away, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.ex: He decided to follow his heart and become an artist.
words.ex_cn: 他决定追随内心，成为一名艺术家。
words.en: To act according to one's feelings or desires rather than logic or reason.

words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.ex: He aspires to be a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望成为一名飞行员。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or reach it.

words.ex: The man was in disguise at the party.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人在聚会上乔装打扮。
words.en: Concealed or disguised; not in one's true form or identity.

words.tr: v. 满足需要；“cater”的现在分词； n. 包办饮食；
words.ex: The new service is catering to the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这项新服务正在满足学生的需求。
words.en: The business of providing food and drink for events or occasions.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.ex: The temperature rose steadily throughout the day.
words.ex_cn: 白天温度稳定地上升。
words.en: If something happens or changes steadily, it happens or changes in a regular way without interruption.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.ex: The operator answered the call at the switchboard.
words.ex_cn: 接线员在交换台接听了电话。
words.en: A switchboard is a device that allows telephone calls to be connected to the correct lines, especially in a large office or organization.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr: n. 公寓的看门人；门房；服务台职员；
words.ex: The concierge helped me carry my bags to the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 公寓的看门人帮我把行李搬到了公寓。
words.en: A concierge is a person who looks after a building, especially a large one such as a hotel or apartment block, and who helps people with their requests.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: The VIP sat at the front table.
words.ex_cn: 大人物坐在前排的桌子旁。
words.en: A very important person, someone who is accorded special privileges due to their status or importance.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.ex: Her friendliness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 她的友好让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: The quality of being friendly; affability.

words.ex: Fish abound in this river.
words.ex_cn: 这条河里鱼很多。
words.en: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them.

words.ex: He ran swiftly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: If something is done swiftly, it is done quickly and without delay.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: He is the liaison between the two departments.
words.ex_cn: 他是两个部门之间的联络人。
words.en: A liaison is a person who acts as a link to assist communication between different groups or organizations.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: I met with an old friend at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。
words.en: to experience or encounter something, especially something that is unexpected or unpleasant; to have a meeting with someone.

words.ex: We will have our friends over for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们会邀请朋友来家里吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone to one's home.

words.ex: Here's your cookie — there you go.
words.ex_cn: 这是你的饼干——给你。
words.en: Used to present something to someone, often as a solution or offering.

words.tr: phrase. 逐步使自己地位上升；获得晋升
words.ex: He started as a cleaner and worked his way up to manager.
words.ex_cn: 他从清洁工做起，一步步升到了经理。
words.en: To gradually progress or advance in a job, position, or status through effort and hard work.

words.ex: He took the initiative to help the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 他主动帮助老人过马路。
words.en: To take the initiative means to be the first one to take action in a situation, often with the aim of solving a problem or improving a situation.

words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr:
adj. 无数的；
n. 无数；
words.ex: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A myriad of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: The city is facing problems because of rapid urbanization.
words.ex_cn: 由于快速的城市化，这座城市正面临问题。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: The school is multicultural, with students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是多元文化的，学生来自许多国家。
words.en: Relating to or containing several cultural or ethnic groups within a society.

words.ex: He is evidently tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走完漫长的路后显然很累。
words.en: In a way that is clearly seen or understood; obviously.

words.ex: The company wants to globalize its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想将业务全球化。
words.en: To make something worldwide in scope or application.

words.tr: adj. 使用多种语言的；说多种语言的；
words.ex: He is a multilingual teacher who speaks three languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位会说三种语言的多语言教师。
words.en: Using or able to use several languages.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: New York is a melting pot of many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是多种文化的熔炉。
words.en: A place where different peoples, styles, theories, etc., are mixed together.

words.tr: adj. 西班牙的；西班牙和葡萄牙的；拉丁美洲的
words.ex: He is a Hispanic student from Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自西班牙的西班牙裔学生。
words.en: relating to Spain or to Spanish-speaking countries, especially those of Latin America.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: He is an interpreter for the United Nations.
words.ex_cn: 他是联合国的口译员。
words.en: An interpreter is a person whose job is to translate what someone is saying into another language, especially in a situation where people are speaking different languages.

words.tr: adj. 分歧的；发散的；趋异的；
words.ex: The two friends had divergent opinions about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这两个朋友对这部电影的看法不同。
words.en: If two things diverge, they are different from each other, or they become different from each other.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: He is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 他只会说英语，不懂其他语言。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.ex: He outscored his friend in the basketball game.
words.ex_cn: 他在篮球比赛中得分比朋友多。
words.en: To outscore someone or something means to gain more points or goals than them in a game or competition.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: She showed empathy when her friend cried.
words.ex_cn: 当她的朋友哭泣时，她表现出了同感。
words.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: He gets stronger day by day.
words.ex_cn: 他一天天变得更强壮。
words.en: Gradually over a period of time.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.tr: adj. 无瑕疵的；无缺点的；
words.ex: Her performance was flawless.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演毫无瑕疵。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is flawless, you mean that they are extremely good and that there are no faults or problems with them.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr: n. 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母
words.ex: My grandparent lives in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A grandparent is the parent of your father or mother.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: He is a renaissance man who paints, writes, and builds robots.
words.ex_cn: 他是个全才，会画画、写作和制造机器人。
words.en: A Renaissance man is a person who is skilled in multiple fields or has a broad base of knowledge, reflecting the ideal of the Renaissance period where individuals were encouraged to develop their talents in various areas.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.ex: The cowboy rode his horse on the mesa.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔骑着马在台地上奔跑。
words.en: A mesa is a flat-topped mountain or hill with steep sides, found primarily in the southwestern United States.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: The restaurant serves southwestern food.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供西南风味的食物。
words.en: Southwestern means in or from the southwest part of a place or country.

words.ex: The mountain is a natural landform.
words.ex_cn: 这座山是一个天然的地貌。
words.en: A landform is a natural feature of the Earth's surface, such as a mountain, valley, or plateau.

words.ex: He blurted out the secret by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心说出了秘密。
words.en: If someone blurts something, they say it suddenly, after trying hard to keep quiet or to keep it secret.

words.ex: Ah, I see what you mean.
words.ex_cn: 啊，我明白你的意思了。
words.en: used to express surprise, pleasure, or sympathy

words.ex: The children saw a big rainforest on their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了一片热带雨林。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall, typically located near the equator.

words.ex: He lives in a small casa near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他住在海边的一座小房子里。
words.en: In Spanish, 'casa' refers to a house or home, a place where one lives.

words.tr:
n. 明显的伪装；装模作样
(~s：看手势猜字谜游戏)
words.ex: His apology was a charade to hide his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他的道歉是一种明显的伪装，为了隐藏他真实的情感。
words.en: A charade is a situation in which people pretend that something is true when it clearly is not, or a game in which one team acts out a word or phrase for the other team to guess.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.ex: The trash receptacle is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: A receptacle is an object or space used to contain something.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr: phrase. 波多黎各人；波多黎各的
words.ex: He is a Puerto Rican artist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位波多黎各艺术家。
words.en: relating to Puerto Rico or its people

words.ex: He eats jewish food on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日吃犹太人的食物。
words.en: Jewish means relating to the religion, culture, or people of the Jews.

words.tr:
n. 希伯来语；
adj. 希伯来人的；
words.ex: He speaks Hebrew fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说希伯来语。
words.en: Hebrew refers to the language, people, or culture of the ancient Israelites, or to the modern form of the language spoken in Israel.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.tr: n. （西班牙语国家的）城区；（美国城市的）西语区
words.ex: He lives in a quiet barrio near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 他住在市中心附近的一个安静街区。
words.en: A district of a town in Spain or Spanish-speaking countries, especially one where the people are poor.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: He tried to evade the police by driving fast.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过高速驾驶来逃避警察。
words.en: If you evade something, you find a way of not doing something that you really ought to do.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.ex: The teacher made it easy on the students by giving simple homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过布置简单的作业来减轻学生的负担。
words.en: To make a situation less difficult or demanding for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人很容易（做某事）
words.ex: He made it easy for her to understand the math.
words.ex_cn: 他让她很容易理解这道数学题。
words.en: To enable someone to do something without difficulty.

words.ex: A good idea comes to mind when I walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 当我散步时，一个好主意浮现在脑海中。
words.en: If something comes to mind, you suddenly remember it or think of it.

words.ex: The teacher singled out one student for praise.
words.ex_cn: 老师挑出一名学生进行表扬。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 不知道；不清楚；不了解
words.ex: I have no idea where the bus stop is.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道公交车站在哪里。
words.en: If you have no idea about something, you do not know anything about it or you have no understanding of it.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: He uses cloud computing to store his files.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云计算来存储文件。
words.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of different services through the Internet, including data storage, servers, databases, networking, and software.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.ex: He can foretell the weather by looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过观察天空来预知天气。
words.en: To tell or indicate beforehand; predict.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: He uses an app to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个应用程序来学习英语。
words.en: An app is a computer program that is designed for a specific purpose, especially one that can be downloaded onto a mobile device.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.tr: adv. 猛烈地；狠狠地；拼命地；猛地；
words.ex: The dogs fought fiercely over the bone.
words.ex_cn: 狗们猛烈地争抢那根骨头。
words.en: In a way that is very strong or intense, often in a manner that is aggressive or violent.

words.tr: v. 求爱；求婚；寻求支持
words.ex: He tried to woo her with flowers and chocolates.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和巧克力追求她。
words.en: If you woo someone, you try to persuade them to marry you or to have a relationship with you, or you try to gain their support or favor.

words.tr: v. 彻底变革；使革命化；
words.ex: The new technology will revolutionize how we learn.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将彻底变革我们的学习方式。
words.en: To completely change something, especially in a way that improves it.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的到来改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.ex: I went to the park with my buddy.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的同伴去了公园。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend.

words.ex: This decision is pivotal for the company's future.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对公司未来至关重要。
words.en: Of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something else.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: The portability of this phone makes it easy to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的便携性让它容易携带。
words.en: The quality of being able to be easily carried or moved.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.ex: He worked hard and reaped the rewards.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，获得了回报。
words.en: To reap means to cut and gather a crop, or to obtain something, especially as a result of effort.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.ex: The netizen posted a comment on the video.
words.ex_cn: 这位网民在视频下留言了。
words.en: A netizen is a person who uses the internet, especially as a member of a particular online community.

words.tr: n. 入门；大门；入口网站
words.ex: This book is a portal to learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是学习英语的入门。
words.en: A portal is a large and imposing entrance, doorway, or gate, or a website that provides access or links to other sites.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: It is probable that he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天来的可能性很大。
words.en: If you say that something is probable, you mean that it is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: He uses e-learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线学习在家学习数学。
words.en: E-learning refers to the use of electronic technologies to access educational curriculum outside of a traditional classroom.

words.ex: He joined a webinar about math tricks.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于数学技巧的网络研讨会。
words.en: A webinar is a seminar conducted over the internet, allowing participants to engage in discussions and presentations remotely.

words.ex: We had a teleconference with the team in Japan.
words.ex_cn: 我们与日本的团队进行了电话会议。
words.en: A teleconference is a meeting that is held using a telephone or video system, allowing people in different places to participate.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: He picked up the handset to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起手机给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A handset is a device that is held in the hand, especially one that is used as part of a telephone or radio.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: This song is popularly played on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌普遍地在收音机里播放。
words.en: If something is popularly known as a particular thing, most people know it by that name.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The router has low bandwidth, so videos load slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这个路由器带宽很低，所以视频加载很慢。
words.en: Bandwidth refers to the maximum rate of data transfer across a given path.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The new technology will usher in a better future.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将开启一个更美好的未来。
words.en: To usher in something means to be at the start of a new period, especially one that involves important changes or improvements.

words.ex: When she went to college, she finally had the chance to spread her wings.
words.ex_cn: 当她上大学时，终于有机会展翅高飞了。
words.en: To begin to do new and exciting things that one was not able to do before, especially after a period of being restricted or limited.

words.ex: I have no more apples.
words.ex_cn: 我再也没有苹果了。
words.en: used to say that something will not continue or happen again

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我的钢笔。
words.en: If you give or do something in exchange for something else, you give or do it in order to get that thing.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the eye of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴眼中心保持冷静。
words.en: The calm region at the center of a storm or hurricane, where winds are light and the weather is often clear.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: The new phone will come with a free case.
words.ex_cn: 新手机将附带一个免费的手机壳。
words.en: If something comes with a particular thing, the thing is included or provided as part of it.

words.ex: People look upon him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 人们把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.ex: The conference aims to bring together experts from various fields.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议旨在汇集来自不同领域的专家。
words.en: To cause people or things to come together in one place or for a common purpose.

words.ex: He wants to make his mark as a great artist.
words.ex_cn: 他想作为一名伟大的艺术家崭露头角。
words.en: To achieve something notable or to leave a significant impression in a particular field or area.

words.ex: The new restaurant is the talk of the town.
words.ex_cn: 这家新餐厅是大家热议的话题。
words.en: If someone or something is the talk of the town, they are the main subject of conversation in that place.

words.tr: n. 勒德分子；反对使用新技术的人；
words.ex: He is a luddite who refuses to use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 他是个拒绝使用智能手机的勒德分子。
words.en: A Luddite is someone who is opposed to the introduction of new working methods, especially new machines.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: He lost his hearing and became deafness.
words.ex_cn: 他失去了听力，变成了耳聋。
words.en: Deafness is the condition of not being able to hear anything or not being able to hear very well.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: He listens to music with earbuds.
words.ex_cn: 他用耳塞听音乐。
words.en: A small device that fits into the ear to listen to music or other audio privately.

words.tr:
v. 叫喊
n. 喊叫
words.ex: He yells when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会大喊。
words.en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.ex: His inability to swim saved him from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 他不会游泳，这救了他一命。
words.en: If you refer to someone's inability to do something, you are emphasizing that they cannot do it.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.ex: The muscle showed signs of atrophy after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后，肌肉出现了萎缩的迹象。
words.en: Atrophy refers to the wasting away or decrease in size of an organ or tissue, typically as a result of disease, injury, or lack of use.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.tr:
adj. 无组织的；混乱的；杂乱无章的
v. 使混乱；瓦解；扰乱；“disorganize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: His desk is disorganized and messy.
words.ex_cn: 他的桌子杂乱无章。
words.en: If you describe something as disorganized, you mean that it is not arranged in a neat or orderly way, or that it is not planned or managed well.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: The app has an intuitive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序具有直观的设计。
words.en: An intuitive idea or feeling is based on an instinctive emotional response rather than on conscious thought.

words.ex: The phone has good connectivity in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机在农村地区的网络连接很好。
words.en: Connectivity refers to the state or extent of being connected or interconnected, especially in the context of computer systems or networks.

words.tr:
v. 衰落；减弱；缺；亏
n. 衰退；减弱；缺；亏
words.ex: The moon begins to wane after the full moon.
words.ex_cn: 满月之后，月亮开始变暗。
words.en: If something wanes, it becomes gradually weaker or less, often so that it eventually disappears.

words.ex: The country faced balkanization after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争之后，这个国家陷入了分裂。
words.en: The process by which a region or country breaks up into smaller, often hostile, units.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: v. 以朋友态度对待；帮助
words.ex: He decided to befriend the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他决定结交那个新生。
words.en: To befriend someone means to act as a friend to them by offering help, support, or companionship.

words.ex: The set of even numbers is a subgroup of the integers.
words.ex_cn: 偶数的集合是整数的一个子群。
words.en: A subgroup is a distinct and often subordinate group within a larger group.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.tr: n. 荒野；[地理]沼泽；系泊（moor 的复数）; v. 使停泊；被系住（moor 的三单形式）
words.ex: The sheep walk on the moors near the village.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在村庄附近的荒原上行走。
words.en: Moors are areas of open, uncultivated land, often covered with heather, that are found in parts of Britain and other countries.

words.ex: He gave a puffed-up speech about his small achievements.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一番夸大其词的演讲，吹嘘自己微不足道的成就。
words.en: If you describe someone as puffed-up, you disapprove of them because they are very proud of themselves and think that they are very important.

words.tr: n. 吹牛大王；自吹自擂的人
words.ex: He's just a blowhard who never backs up his boasts with actions.
words.ex_cn: 他只是个光说不练的吹牛大王。
words.en: A blowhard is someone who talks in a loud and boastful way, often exaggerating their achievements or abilities.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.ex: The small country has a dependency on foreign aid.
words.ex_cn: 这个小国依赖外国援助。
words.en: A dependency is a situation in which someone or something relies on someone or something else for support or existence.

words.tr:
v. 潦草地写；匆匆地写；乱涂乱画
n. 潦草的字迹；涂鸦
words.ex: He scribbled his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上潦草地写了名字。
words.en: To scribble means to write or draw something quickly or carelessly.

words.ex: The handwriting is legible and easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 字迹清晰，容易辨认。
words.en: If writing or print is legible, it is clear enough to read.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr: n. 喜欢烧烤野餐的人，烧烤野餐爱好者
words.ex: The bbqer grilled chicken at the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个烧烤者在公园里烤了鸡肉。
words.en: A person who enjoys cooking or grilling food, especially meat, over an open fire or barbecue.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He sat in the mid row of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在教室的中间一排。
words.en: Mid is used to describe something that is in the middle of a range or series.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: The cat disappeared behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫从房子后面消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go away or are taken away so that you cannot see them any more.

words.ex: He signed his name in the yearbook.
words.ex_cn: 他在年鉴上签了自己的名字。
words.en: A yearbook is a book published annually by a school, college, or university, recording the events and achievements of the previous year and often containing photographs of students and faculty.

words.ex: Warm weather favors plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气有利于植物生长。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favor, you like or support them.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.ex: We sat around the campfire and told stories.
words.ex_cn: 我们围坐在篝火旁讲故事。
words.en: A campfire is a fire that is made outdoors, especially by people who are camping.

words.tr:
n. 自带酒水
abbr. 自带酒水；“bring your own bottle/booze）”的缩写
words.ex: Please bring your own beer to the party.
words.ex_cn: 请自带啤酒来参加派对。
words.en: An acronym for 'Bring Your Own Bottle/Beverage/Beer', used to indicate that guests should bring their own alcoholic beverages to a party or event.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.ex: I think of my teacher as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把我的老师当作朋友。
words.en: To consider someone or something in a particular way.

words.ex: He lords it over his little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都对弟弟摆架子。
words.en: To behave in a superior and domineering manner towards someone.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在傍晚落下。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地；诚挚地；正正经经
words.ex: He started working in earnest after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后认真开始工作。
words.en: If you do something in earnest, you do it with serious and sincere intentions.

words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.ex: He points to the door when he wants to leave.
words.ex_cn: 当他想离开时，他指向门。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something as being likely or true.

words.ex: Enough said, let's move on.
words.ex_cn: 说够了，我们继续吧。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is so obvious or well known that it does not need to be explained or discussed further.

words.tr: phrase. 屈服于；向…让步；投降
words.ex: Don't give in to fear when you face a challenge.
words.ex_cn: 当你面对挑战时，不要向恐惧屈服。
words.en: To yield to someone or something, especially after resisting for a period of time.

words.ex: Most students are in the majority when they choose math over art.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生选择数学而不是艺术时，他们就占多数。
words.en: To constitute more than half of a group or population.
